# CANDIDATE: OR_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
After an opening range break, price often reverts to VWAP as intraday liquidity draws back, providing a high‑probability pullback long. This edge exists because institutional algorithms often use VWAP as a benchmark for reversion after initial momentum exhausts.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: If price breaks above the opening range high within the first 5 minutes (09:30-10:00 ET), then within the next 10 minutes (10:00-10:10 ET) price pulls back to touch VWAP (within 0.1% tolerance) and forms a bullish candle (close > open) with volume > 1.2x the average volume of the first 5 minutes, enter long at the close of that candle. Exit shape: Chart‑stop at the opening range low (structure invalidation), initial target at 1.5R, with a runner trailed 10% off the highest‑water‑mark.
